name: v0.1.0
body:
Ad-hoc signed, not notarised: first open with right-click, then Open.
Or run: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine contr-rune.app

## What's Changed
* Part 1: tokens and window shell by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/1
* AGENTS.md and the rune-kit plan by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/2
* K1: kit foundation and shell by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/4
* K2: tabs on TabStrip by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/5
* K3: terminal panel by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/6
* K4: sidebar on rune-kit by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/7
* K5: title bar right side by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/8
* K6: files panel by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/9
* Polish: sidebar details and README by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/10
* K7a: Settings and light theme by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/11
* K7b: search in the terminal by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/12
* K7c: split terminal by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/13
* H1: hc client, fake core, hc version in Settings by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/14
* H2: framed codec and fake framed core by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/15
* H3: tabs are hc terminals by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/16
* H4: reopen and re-attach hc terminals by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/17
* H5: agent rows in the sidebar by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/18
* H6: live agent state and needs-you by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/19
* H7: hc status probe and its result by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/20
* H8: selecting an agent shows its terminal by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/21
* AGENTS.md: use the BeautifulRust skills by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/23
* AGENTS.md: scope and test rules by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/24
* HC-PLAN: Claude Code reports status natively (drop H7b) by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/25
* Fix flaky closing_a_terminal_unsplits test by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/22
* H9: questions notch and card by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/26
* R1: build a macOS .app by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/27
* R2: release CI on version tag by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/28
* Release workflow: use macos-latest (macos-14 runners are retired) by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/29
* Test speed 1: split and find tests on the fake hc terminal by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/30
* Ignore agent worktrees by @contursofran in https://github.com/contursofran/contr-rune/pull/31
